title: Deployment fleetd probe hardcodes protocol version 1
wanted_capability: Use the deployment readiness and empty-session probe across supported fleetd protocol upgrades.
missing_primitive: The operator-side migration/probe-fleetd.mjs offers only version 1 and stamps every frame with version 1, so it cannot inspect a protocol-2 fleetd.
fallback_used: Updated the probe to offer versions 2 and 1 and frame requests with the negotiated version.
notes: Version-1 empty-session probe passed. Version-2 verification follows installation of the new fleetd.
resolution_note: Deployment probe now offers fleetd protocols 2 and 1 and uses the negotiated version in every frame. Syntax validation passed. Live empty-session probes passed against protocol-1 fleetd and protocol-2 fleetd, and the protocol-2 invalid-token probe returned auth.invalid.
